=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py:687 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `assert ci.count("CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}") == 6` finds 1 occurrence, so tests-system-python (12), tests-sandbox-python (codex-isolated-codex) and orchestrate-poll (3) fail on head ba1b1c34.
  WHY: This is base-branch drift. The PR checkout's .github/workflows/ci.yml has all 6 occurrences, and the PR changes neither ci.yml nor the test. Required CI stays red, and the fix is a rebase, a merge of the base or a base-branch fix. Both reviewers rate it NIT.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:Scripts section (no entries for scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh or scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: tests/inventory_parity.py fails the tests-release-and-log-analysis job because the inventory has no entries for scripts that README.md:149 and agents.md:2088/2090 reference.
  WHY: The job exits 1 on both head and merge-base for a reason unrelated to this PR, so it gives no signal on the PR's own log-analysis tests. The fix belongs on the base branch, and none of these files are in the PR diff. Both reviewers rate it NIT.
- scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:237-238 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic "Recorded section base ... is not in the delivery checkout..." comes right before the `git merge-base` check that fails with `section_base_invalid`, and together they give a misleading error.
  WHY: An operator would think the base SHA is missing from the checkout when the real cause is that the fetch sequence failed to reach it, which wastes investigation time. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 disputed this: the line prints only when `git cat-file -e` cannot find the base object, and the reason key is unchanged.
- scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:212-217, 240-246 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The best-effort target-only re-fetches send their output to /dev/null at line 216. When the base stays unreachable, the only trace is the diagnostic at line 241, so an operator cannot tell a fetch or depth failure from a genuinely wrong base.
  WHY: A production `section_base_invalid` failure would carry no fetch-log evidence, which works against the operational-clarity intent of the diagnostic line. The last-run diff introduced this gap by routing the new fetches to /dev/null instead of the existing `fetch_log`. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and openai_gpt-6-luna raised the same issue only as hardening suggestions.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
